data: {{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:IsedwaChuwant-AcolyteVG.png]] |name=Isedwa Chuwant |homeworld=[[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]]{{Databank|senator-isedwa-chuwant|Senator Isedwa Chuwant}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Abednedo]]{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |height=1.87 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Gray]]{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The review should not be cause for alarm.|Isdedwa Chuwant|}} '''Isedwa Chuwant''' was an [[Abednedo]] [[Senator]] who represented the [[planet]] [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] during the last decades of the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], Chuwant gave [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] an update on the Senate, informing her that Senator [[Worus Rayencourt]]'s support among his peers was growing and that he was preparing an external review of the [[Jedi Order]]. After a short discussion with Chuwant, Rwoh excused herself to speak with [[Padawan]] [[Mog Adana]]. The Senator later participated in a tribunal where Rwoh deceived [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Veeth Drellik]] and the tribunal's senators, framing [[Jedi]] Master [[Sol]] for the [[Mae's quest|crimes]] of the [[Force-sensitive]] [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae Aniseya]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|This is the case of an ambitious senator grasping for power.|Isdedwa Chuwant|}} Isedwa Chuwant was an Abednedo [[Politics|politician]] who served as a [[Senator]] of the planet''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]'' Abednedo in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s senate during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Chuwant gave the [[Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]]{{SW|url=teach-corrupt-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Teach / Corrupt" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}} an update on the current situation in the Senate, telling her that Senator [[Worus Rayencourt]] was gaining support and preparing an external review of the [[Jedi Order]] for a vote by the Senate. Chuwant also added that his fellow senators from the [[Expansion Region]] would vote in support of the review. The Abednedo assured Rwoh that she should not be alarmed by the review despite her worries, as the Order had a tradition of transparency with the Senate and that Rayencourt was merely an ambitious senator grasping for power. Their conversation was interrupted by [[Padawan]] [[Mog Adana]]{{Databank|mog-adana|Mog Adana}} who needed to speak with Rwoh. The Jedi Master thanked Chuwant for his update and excused herself, turning off the [[holoprojector]]. [[File:VernestraSenateTribunal-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|left|300px|Vernestra Rwoh deceived the Senate tribunal about the truth behind the murders.]] Later, Rwoh was summoned in front of a Senate tribunal led by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Veeth Drellik]], which Chuwant was a part of. Rwoh reported to the tribunal that a [[Jedi]] Master named [[Sol]] had gone rogue, [[Death|killing]] the other three Jedi who participated in a [[Mission to Brendok|mission]] to the planet [[Brendok]] [[148 BBY|sixteen years]] earlier in order to cover up the four's involvement in destroying a [[The Force|Force]] [[Brendok coven|cult]]. The Jedi Master deceived the tribunal however, covering up the fact that the Jedi were actually [[Mae's quest|murdered]] by the [[Force-sensitive]] [[assassin]]{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae Aniseya]].{{Databank|mae|Mae Aniseya}} Rayencourt insisted that in light of the events an external review of the Order must begin immediately, but Drellik asked Rwoh what became of Sol. She explained to the [[Tarsunt]] Chancellor that he was found dead on Brendok, and speculated that he killed himself, while in reality he was killed by his former Padawan [[Verosha Aniseya|Osha Aniseya]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The Jedi are always transparent with the Senate.|Isedwa Chuwant|}} [[File:IsedwaChuwant-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|200px|right|Chuwant was a trusted ally of the Jedi Order.]] Isedwa Chuwant was an Abednedo with [[Color|gray]] skin. As a senator, Chuwant was knowledgeable in the inner workings of the Galactic Senate, being able to provide his trusted ally Vernestra Rwoh with updates on Senate matters and gossip. He was loyal to the Jedi Order, believing the Order to be transparent with the Senate and hoping to ensure Worus Rayencourt does not limit the Order's ability to operate too much. Chuwant was also distrustful of Rayencourt. ==Equipment== While reporting to Rwoh and during the Senate tribunal, Chuwant wore an [[Clothing|outfit]] featuring a dark green [[cape]] with a tall collar and a multi-layered gray garment that covered his torso and had black and green sleeves. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Happy to be back for more voiceover in @starwars! Voiced Senator Isedwa Chuwant of Abednedo in episode 6 of #TheAcolyte #voiceactor #Voiceover|archivedate=https://archive.is/RpT51}}}} Isedwa Chuwant first appeared via hologram in "[[Teach / Corrupt]]," the sixth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: The Acolyte|''The Acolyte'']], which released on [[July 2]], [[2024]],{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-6-teach-corrupt-episode-guide|text="Teach / Corrupt" - Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} albeit only identified as Chuwant. The Abednedo was identified by their full name in a [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry the following day. [[Dee Tails]] was the performance artist for Chuwant, while [[David W. Collins]] provided the voice of the character. The Trivia Gallery in the Episode Guide for "Teach / Corrupt" revealed that Chuwant's name continues the tradition of Abednedo receiving their names from songs by [[Wikipedia:Beastie Boys|Beastie Boys]], being named after a lyric of the song "[[Wikipedia:So What'cha Want|So What'cha Want]]." ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} {{1st}} {{Hologram}} *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-6-teach-corrupt-episode-guide|text="Teach / Corrupt" - Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-highlights-teach-corrupt|text=''The Acolyte'' Explained | Highlights from "Teach / Corrupt"}} *{{SW|url=news/ilm-the-acolyte-vfx-interview|text=Lightsabers & Magic: Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy on The Acolyte's Creatures and Weapons of the Jedi}} *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Databank|senator-isedwa-chuwant|Senator Isedwa Chuwant}} {{1stID|Isedwa}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-character-quiz|text=Quiz: Which Character from ''The Acolyte'' Are You?}} {{Interlang |es=Isedwa Chuwant |fr=Isedwa Chuwant |ka=ისედვა ჩუვანტი |nl=Isedwa Chuwant |pl=Isedwa Chuwant }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Chuwant, Isedwa}} [[Category:Abednedo]] [[Category:Galactic Republic senators during the High Republic Era]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
